provenance: AUTHORED 2026-08-17, Wave 2 Track A. Every `clause` was COPIED BY HAND, character for character, out of the matching `physical_outcome` in content/magic/*.json (bundled to public/content/magic.json). Nothing here is regex-derived: all 18 stateful outcomes share the shape 'State-dependent: A; B', and several branches carry their own semicolons and em-dashes, so a split-by-pattern would silently render the wrong half of the prose. tests/ReceiverState.test.ts asserts every clause is a verbatim substring of its record, so content drift fails a test instead of reaching a player. State ids, labels, `initial` and `becomes` are design data authored here; the prose is not.

states.label: unlit — stocked, or long cold and down to dead ash

branches.clause: dead ash only swirls — breath feeds fire, it does not start one
branches.note: The ash physically swirls, so this is a diminished effect, not an authored nothing. Reviewed as borderline.

branches.clause: banked embers brighten and flare under the draft
banked embers brighten and flare under the draft
branches.note: Same authored clause as lit_by_hand. Embers are embers however the fire was started; breath does not read residue, glimmer does.

branches.clause: caught early, it dries flat with the ink intact
branches.note: No authored 'dried' state exists on this receiver, so `becomes` stays null rather than invent one.

branches.clause: if the ink has already run, it dries smeared — dry fixes wet, not ruin
hanging free, the bell reproduces the sound with its own ring under it
muffled or held, only a dull knock escapes
unlatched, it swings open toward the pull
latched, it rattles once and holds
branches.note: It rattles — an authored physical result, so not a no-effect. Reviewed as borderline.

branches.clause: tilled and soft, a clean furrow opens the cast's length
packed hard or frozen, only a scuffed line — the ground has to be worked first
lit by hand or long cold, none rise
branches.note: Borderline. 'none rise' is close to an authored nothing, but the author did not use the no_effect marker here and this table does not upgrade prose into a marker. Flip it in this file if Roc rules otherwise — no code changes.

branches.clause: lit by hand or long cold, none rise
branches.note: One clause covers both conditions because the author wrote both into it: 'lit by hand or long cold'.

branches.clause: recently magic-lit, a few lights dance at the firebox mouth
branches.note: Reachable because `ignite` on a cold furnace sets magic_lit. That chain is authored content talking to itself, not new machinery.

branches.clause: on festival night, the grounds fill with dancing lights far past what any one surface carries — the past casts of many years rise and dance at once
on any ordinary day, only the sparse traces of recent local casts rise and fade
unlit and stocked, the banked fuel catches and the furnace lights, draft picking up
already lit, nothing changes
already lit, nothing changes
wick dressed for the rite, the sent flame takes and burns steady
wick bare, the flame touches metal and dies — the cast's flame is spent either way
wicks dressed for the rite, the one sent flame runs lantern to lantern along the whole span in one pass
wicks undressed, it dies at the first bare one
full, it measures out into even servings
near-empty, it still parts even — into portions too small to serve anyone
just-picked, the berries hold at ripe
branches.note: The hold keeps the basket in the state it is already in, so no transition.

branches.clause: already turning, the soft ones stay soft — the hold is not a rewind
still knitting, the itch around the scab quiets and the scab stays unbroken
long healed over, nothing itches and nothing happens
dry wrapping seals tight at every seam
soaked wrapping will not take the seal until it dries
branches.note: Borderline. Refusal is described as a condition of the wrapping, not with the no_effect marker, so it is left an effect. One JSON edit flips it.

branches.clause: with herbs in it, the water takes their colour and virtue in moments
plain, no_effect — there is nothing to draw
branches.note: One of the two mid-string no_effect markers the anchored regex in CastResolver could never see.

branches.clause: glowing hot, it hardens evenly with a hiss and holds its shape
already cold, no_effect — there is no heat to set
branches.note: The headline case. Setting the metal takes the heat out of it, so a second temper on the same billet is the authored nothing.

branches.clause: backing up and smoky, the draft rights itself and pulls clean
drawing fine already, nothing changes
full, it hangs low off its resting place and the hang reads the batch
scraped empty, it hangs high — only the pot's own weight left to bear
